mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT RV.RECRUIT_VIEW_NO, RV.USER_ID, RV.RECRUITMENT_NO, CASE WHEN (CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS DATE) - CAST(RV.VIEW_AT AS DATE)) * 24 >= 24 THEN FLOOR((CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS DATE) - CAST(RV.VIEW_AT AS DATE)) * 24 / 24) ELSE ROUND((CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS DATE) - CAST(RV.VIEW_AT AS DATE)) * 24) END AS VIEW_AT, RN.RECRUITMENT_TITLE, RN.RECRUITMENT_SALARY, RN.WELFARE, RN.CITY_CODE, RN.DISTRICT_CODE, RN.YEAR_CODE, ROUND(RN.RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE - SYSDATE) AS RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE, C.COM_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RV.RECRUITMENT_NO ORDER BY RV.VIEW_AT DESC) AS RNK FROM RECRUIT_VIEW RV LEFT JOIN RECRUITMENT_NOTICE RN ON RV.RECRUITMENT_NO = RN.RECRUITMENT_NO LEFT JOIN COMPANY C ON C.USER_ID = RN.USER_ID WHERE RV.USER_ID = #{userId} ) WHERE RNK = 1 AND ROWNUM <= 10 ORDER BY VIEW_AT, RECRUITMENT_TITLE

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT RV.RECRUIT_VIEW_NO as RECRUIT_VIEW_NO, RV.USER_ID as USER_ID, RV.RECRUITMENT_NO as RECRUITMENT_NO, CASE WHEN (CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS DATE) - CAST(RV.VIEW_AT AS DATE)) * 24 >= 24 THEN FLOOR((CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS DATE) - CAST(RV.VIEW_AT AS DATE)) * 24 / 24) ELSE ROUND((CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS DATE) - CAST(RV.VIEW_AT AS DATE)) * 24) END AS VIEW_AT, RN.RECRUITMENT_TITLE as RECRUITMENT_TITLE, RN.RECRUITMENT_SALARY as RECRUITMENT_SALARY, RN.WELFARE as WELFARE, RN.CITY_CODE AS CITY_CODE, RN.DISTRICT_CODE AS DISTRICT_CODE, RN.YEAR_CODE AS YEAR_CODE, ROUND(RN.RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE - SYSDATE) AS RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE, C.COM_NAME as COM_NAME FROM RECRUIT_VIEW RV LEFT JOIN RECRUITMENT_NOTICE RN ON RV.RECRUITMENT_NO = RN.RECRUITMENT_NO LEFT JOIN COMPANY C ON C.USER_ID = RN.USER_ID WHERE RN.RECRUITMENT_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ORDER BY VIEW_AT, RECRUITMENT_TITLE ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10
